mobbin:d3ffcd9d-2646-4c40-aa25-7fc37e0fb.summary: From Security & Drivers with Sentry Mode on, the user opens 'View live camera' and sees one live feed, a vehicle diagram of camera positions, Honk/Flash, and a record control.
steps: Security & Drivers: Sentry on, View live camera
Live Camera feed with vehicle camera map
steal: Sentry Mode must be ON before 'View live camera' (screen 1), so live view only opens when monitoring is already on.
A floor-plan style map shows position dots and view wedges around the subject (screen 2), so the user picks a camera by place, not by a cryptic device name.
A single live preview sits above the map (screen 2), so cameras switch without leaving the monitoring screen.
A grid control beside the map (screen 2) shortcuts toward a multi-angle layout from the same picker.
avoid: Honk and Flash on the camera screen (screen 2) are the wrong metaphor for sim rooms; keep space for PTZ, presets or room/simulator announce instead.
mobbin:d3ffcd9d-2646-4c40-aa25-7fc37e0fb.fit: Recording: informs Center Overview and a simplified camera picker: a room diagram with camera dots to switch the live feed, not continuous PTZ and no face ID.
